Messages.Author: Markus Schlein
Messages.Body:
Hi,

I have a question about the sections 4.2 and 4.3 of the V:EKN Tournament
Rules. I am thinking about the changes on Banishment. It is changed in
the most recent printing, but the card is new and so it's not allowed in
tournament play. The question is: Which version of Banishment may I use
in tournament play this week?

Thanks for help,

-Markus
http://www.vekn.de

> 4.2. Card Interpretation
>
>The head judge is the final authority regarding card interpretations.
>All cards are to be interpreted according to their most recent printing.

> 4.3. New Releases
>
>New V:TES cards (new expansions, new editions of the basic set,
>and promotional cards) are promotional cards) are allowed in
>Constructed tournament play beginning 30 days after their retail
>release date. V:EKN announcements confirm the exact date that each
>new card set enters tournament play before the set is released.

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Markus Schlein wrote:
>
> Hi,
>
> I have a question about the sections 4.2 and 4.3 of the V:EKN Tournament
> Rules. I am thinking about the changes on Banishment. It is changed in
> the most recent printing, but the card is new and so it's not allowed in
> tournament play. The question is: Which version of Banishment may I use
> in tournament play this week?

The pre-FN version. That's why FN cards (incl. reprints) are not allowed in
tournaments - so that people don't get confused over the changes in card text
that aren't yet applicable to V:EKN tournaments.
